caption: The drawing contains three stylized floral motifs arranged in a rough triangular composition on a plain off-white background. The two motifs at the top are placed side by side, while the third motif is centered below them. Each motif is outlined with a medium brown line and primarily colored in muted shades of light blue, pale pink, and brown. The motif on the top left features an upper section resembling a flower with a rounded, dot-patterned head and upward curling side extensions, a lower petal-shaped form, and looping lines that end in a filled blue circle. The motif on the top right also consists of an intricate flower with multiple layers of petals, a central cross-hatched oval, two small round side flowers, and ends in a single blue circle at the bottom. The motif at the bottom center consists of a large, curved leaf with blue and green gradients, bearing a curled shape and terminating in a filled blue circle. There is a small inscription in red on the lower right of the image that reads "R.P. MILLAR."
title: Painted Ceiling Decorations
